Name: Realistic condition of Wind Effects
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6647]Wind Effects[/url] and [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-102#post-80633]Unofficial 1.6 Update of Wind Effects[/url], I made this mod. I love to make Stardew Valley become more vivid, but sadly, those 2 just randomly trigger the wind with adjustable probability. This mod changes that!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sxzHjd7v/Thi-t-k-ch-a-c-t-n.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sgR70sr4/Thi-t-k-ch-a-c-t-n-1.gif[/img]﻿

Following the weather on the day, there might have wind. [b]Specifics:[/b]
[spoiler] - [i]Windy weather:[/i] OF COURSE it'll wind! Furthermore, the spring wind is a gentle breeze, but the fall wind is kinda brisk.
 - [i]Stormy weather: [/i]It's storm! WHY NOT? Wind while storming is a gale.
 - [i]Snowy weather: [/i]It's all on you. Default is "false"; if "true", it definitely has wind. Adjust with GMCM or directly on file config.json. 
 - [i]Rainy weather: [/i]Mehh, it depends. 50/50.
 -[i] Other weather (sunny, festival, wedding, green rain, or any other weather mod):[/i] It's a 20% chance, good luck.[/spoiler]

[b][i]Works in multiplayer!
[/i][/b]
[i][b][size=4]Let's enjoy our farmer lives on Stardew~[/size][/b][/i]

Manifest.Name: Realistic Wind Effects
Manifest.Description: Wind blows through Stardew Valley randomly and specific weather days!!
